warning: Edition: 4th edition (Hacker & Schulte revised translation, Wiley-Blackwell 2009), not the 1953 Anscombe text; Part II is renamed 'Philosophy of Psychology – A Fragment' (PPF) with its own remark numbers 1–372. eBook keeps only the English (odd, 'Ne') pages; the German facing pages and the German 'Register' (pp. 267–287) are absent.
method: printed contents p. vii (pdf 11) gives only Part I / Part II. Numbered remarks, no chapters: divisions proposed by remark ranges (~15–33 pdf pages each) at commonly used thematic seams (e.g. §§243–315 private language, PPF xi aspect-seeing); each division's pdf = page where its first remark begins (remark numbers located in text; all 693 + 372 remarks found). Thematic subtitles are mine, so toc_check warnings on these titles are expected. Part I (§§1–693) pdf 34–210, printed 5e–181e; PPF pdf 212–273, 182e–243e. Division sizes: 30, 27, 33, 16, 24, 20, 27, 20, 22, 19 pdf pages. Part I title warning: no heading on pdf 34 (the remarks simply begin; the title page is pdf 29).
